data.notes: May 2026 in Paris is unusually strong for electronic music, with Boiler Room, Cercle Festival, Marvellous Island, Rex Club programming, and several arena-scale pop/R&B concerts.

events.title: Tame Impala at Accor Arena
events.summary: Tame Impala brings the Deadbeat-era European tour to Accor Arena for a single Paris arena date.

events.title: Boiler Room: Paris
events.summary: Boiler Room’s two-night Paris takeover pairs a house-focused Thursday lineup including Chris Stussy, Cassius and Sweely with a Friday techno program featuring Héctor Oaks, Helena Hauff, Trym and BIIA.

events.title: NE-YO & AKON: Nights Like This Tour 2026
events.summary: NE-YO and Akon co-headline Accor Arena on their Nights Like This Tour, billed by the venue as a nostalgia-heavy R&B and pop arena show.

events.title: Supersonic’s Block Party Festival 2026
events.summary: Supersonic’s fourth Block Party edition takes over around ten Bastille-area venues for three days, with 70 international groups listed across the daily programs.

events.title: TWICE <THIS IS FOR> World Tour in Paris
events.summary: K-pop group TWICE plays two Accor Arena dates on the Paris stop of the <THIS IS FOR> World Tour.

events.title: Festival Jazz à Saint-Germain-des-Prés
events.summary: The long-running Saint-Germain jazz festival returns across notable Left Bank venues, presenting headline concerts and emerging jazz talent.

events.title: Festival ManiFeste
events.summary: Ircam-Centre Pompidou’s ManiFeste festival focuses on contemporary creation, electronic music, multimedia and live performance across partner venues in Paris.

events.title: Cercle Festival 2026
events.venueName: Musée de l’Air et de l’Espace, Paris-Le Bourget
events.summary: Cercle Festival returns to Le Bourget for three days with a large international electronic lineup including Eric Prydz, ARTBAT, Adriatique, Kerri Chandler, Kölsch and Ben Böhmer.

events.title: Marvellous Island Festival 2026
events.summary: Marvellous Island’s 14th edition brings its open-air electronic festival format back to Torcy, with Ben Hemsley, Dennis Cruz, Korolova, Mathame, Nic Fanciulli, Reinier Zonneveld, Fatima Hajji and Ilario Alicante among the listed artists.

events.title: Skryptöm: Audrey Danza, Mana Mind, Electric Rescue
events.summary: Skryptöm returns to Rex Club after a six-year absence, with Audrey Danza, Mana Mind and Electric Rescue on the techno lineup.

events.title: Bouss at Accor Arena
events.summary: French rapper Bouss plays two Accor Arena shows after adding a second date, with the venue highlighting his mix of rap, vocals and world-influenced sounds.

events.title: ¡Amour Sauvage Festival #4
events.summary: Cabaret Sauvage hosts the fourth ¡Amour Sauvage Festival, with a techno and downtempo lineup including Etienne Jaumet, DJ Beluga92, Antoine Calvino and Remote.
